title: Benchmark FreeCAD/OpenCascade 2D and 3D CAD capabilities
objective: Produce reproducible empirical evidence for the core CAD capability layer using the current FreeCAD/OpenCascade candidate: professional 2D drafting workflows (precision/coordinate entry, snapping/object inference, layers/visibility, dimensions/annotations, geometric constraints, edit/recompute), 3D geometry (parametric primitives, booleans, transforms/placements, reusable components/assemblies, medium-model robustness), parametric behavior (constrained sketch edit, dimension change propagation, dependency/recompute, failure behavior), and automation/API determinism. This work item does not decide the final CAD/BIM foundation and does not implement a production editor.
acceptance_criteria: Every scoped capability has an executable or manually reproducible test procedure.
At least one representative workflow passes end-to-end for 2D drafting and one for 3D parametric modeling.
Precision behavior is measured with explicit tolerances rather than described qualitatively.
Constraint/edit/recompute behavior is demonstrated with before/after assertions.
Boolean and transform operations have deterministic geometric assertions.
Performance measurements include the fixture characteristics and environment.
All material limitations are documented instead of being silently worked around.
Results are sufficient to support, reject, or defer the CAD geometry candidate under the frozen adapter architecture.
non_goals: No modification of the frozen Construction Graph architecture.
No conclusion that FreeCAD is the final engine.
risk_assumptions: Reuse strategy: the harness and adapter conventions proven in RESEARCH-CAD-001 are vendored/adapted into research/cad-002 so this evidence package is independently reproducible without cross-work-item runtime coupling.

Interactive snapping and TechDraw SVG/PDF export were established as GUI-only in RESEARCH-CAD-001; this benchmark measures the console-observable snapping surface (parameter system, object-inference APIs, adapter-level snapping) and records the GUI boundary explicitly.
FCStd files embed timestamps; byte-level export determinism is expected to fail and is recorded as a finding (semantic determinism is asserted instead).

spec/work-items.md still carries the older RESEARCH-CAD-002 definition (IFC/openBIM fidelity benchmark, RESEARCH-CAD-003 in the issue numbering); this record follows the GitHub issue #2 definition, consistent with the divergence flag recorded in ARCH-WF-001/RESEARCH-CAD-001.
evidence_requirements: Deterministic benchmark suite covering the four scope areas with exact FreeCAD/OCC versions and build environment recorded.
Reproducible fixtures stored in a reproducible format (deterministic parameters; no randomness).
Procedure and commands/scripts to reproduce each result.
Quantitative measurements: operation time, model size, object count, recompute time, peak memory where measurable.
Distinguished native FreeCAD/OCC behavior vs Offisos adapter behavior.
Recorded failures, unsupported operations, precision limitations and nondeterministic behavior.
